findings.title: Swap never used, and the summer-job card is a dull shop-manager interview
findings.expected: He swaps the card he does not want
findings.got: He only agreed. Note: the swap was not exercised again, and the job card was still kept.

judge.voice: Ok, it gave me shooters and cars, so fine, not boring right away. Every card says why it is there, and that is more honest than I expected. I tried the alcohol party, and it just said "for older learners, try another one". No lecture, which I respect, but also no joke and no alternative, so a bit dead. I did not swap anything because I was lazy, and the shop manager card is meh, but a summer job is useful. Would I use it again? Maybe if my parents make me. Saved no time, but it did not waste any either.
